column1: # ─── CyberSecurity Elite — scheduled article queue ────────────────────────
# Format: topic <TAB> section <TAB> intent   (intent optional)
# The scheduled workflow at .github/workflows/generate-article-scheduled.yml
# fires every Monday 14:00 UTC. It pops the FIRST uncommented line, calls
# the Claude pipeline, opens a draft PR, then comments out the processed
# line in this file and pushes the queue update.
# Lines that start with `#` are skipped. Blank lines are skipped. To pause
# the cron entirely, comment out every active line below (or set the
# `cron:` block in the workflow file to a comment).
# Allowed sections: tutorials, posts, news, tools, certifications, bug-bounty,
#                    career, cloud-security, forensics, malware-analysis,
#                    network-security, reverse-engineering, web-security
# Allowed intents:  tutorial, guide, analysis, comparison, news, troubleshooting
#                    (leave blank to let the model auto-classify)
# Curate this file yourself — pipeline quality is bottlenecked by topic
# quality. Five weeks of curated topics is worth more than five hundred
# weeks of generic topics.
# [processed 2026-06-04] ASREProasting Detection in Splunk
LLMNR and NBT-NS Disabling via Group Policy
Pass-the-Hash Detection with Sysmon
Sigma Rule Format: A Practical Reference
Detecting Mimikatz with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
